page: Microsoft Azure M48ds_1_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by an Intel x86_64 processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs and a substantial memory allocation of 974.0 GB, translating to approximately 20.29 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage, the server includes a 410 GB SSD. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external disk options. The instance does not feature any integrated GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU-based machine learning workloads.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio, the M48ds_1_v3 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require massive memory footprints relative to compute resources. It is engineered for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and complex data analytics pipelines that must hold massive datasets in memory to avoid disk latency.
